comparison.objective: Clear a hot soldering iron into its holder before placing a circuit board on the mat.
comparison.physical_skill: Hazard-aware tool handling, cord management, cage insertion, and board placement.
comparison.success_condition: Iron safely caged, board placed, grippers clear, stable for 1 s; hazardous contacts or displacement latch zero. An older version allowed partial board-only credit.
comparison.reason: Tests hazard remediation and ordered workspace preparation, not sifting.
